references.observed: Whole 2025 west-oblique aerial:low entrance range between two larger rectangular tower blocks with front paired round corbelled turrets/cones. Three taller court ranges have inward slate pitches/dormers,light sheet-metal upper roof flats/margins,tall chimney stacks and two small rear roof cupolas. Central quadrangle/arcades remain physically open. Abbey is independent outside the north/east palace edge.

Whole west front distinguishes the older northwest and matching southwest tower blocks,round front corner turrets/cones,banded stone/corbel/parapet cues,differentiated multi-level windows,low central entrance range/roof balustrade and clock/crown gate projection. Fountain/gardens/furniture lie outside principal footprint.

Courtyard close view:actual open round arch bays on square piers with simple columns/pilasters,deep shaded gallery walks and closed windowed back walls. Three ranges have two upper window orders and pitched slate roofs/dormers;front range is lower with one upper order and balustrade. Ground must remain open in court and under arcades,not solid painted arches.

Reverse oblique aerial confirms full quadrangle,two differentiated front tower blocks/round turrets,all three tall ranges,low front link,roofs/dormers/tall chimneys/cupolas and attached rear stair projection. Adjacent roofless abbey/corner tower is separate;palace scope must not replace it.

policy: Four ordinary exterior pictures actually inspected locally,not textures or redistributed images. No bespoke surveys,PDFs,archive studies or downloaded meshes. A Commons courtyard thumbnail returned429;ordinary travel photograph supplied the current inspected close view.
